upstream.source_commit_message: PR: (#12) camera-ready release of the OSSQ-OMR dataset

inventory_scope.description: Tracked source MuseScore/MusicXML annotation history and per-score alignment metadata only. This is not the derived image/segmented-symbolic benchmark release.
inventory_scope.sha_semantics: git_blob_sha1 fields are Git object IDs, not SHA-256 file digests. No raw artifact bytes were acquired or SHA-256 hashed by this metadata inventory.
inventory_scope.acquisition_note: The inventory was generated from the upstream Git tree API and TSV metadata. No binary/source artifact bytes were downloaded into the MUSE repository; Git blob SHA-1 and size are metadata only.
